title: Classical Music
lyrics:
“Into the Promised Land”

Verse 1
In Jerusalem the warning came
A prophet heard the Savior’s name
“Flee the city, take your own
For hearts of stone have overthrown.”
Lehi rose with faithful stand
Sariah walked beside her man
Laman, Lemuel, Sam, and me
Nephi, called to cross the sea.

Pre-Chorus
When the world cried out in rage
And darkness tried to seal our fate
The voice of God still made a way
Beyond the fear, beyond the flames.

Chorus
Into the wilderness we go
Where only faith and trust can grow
When God says move, we will obey
Though we don’t see the road ahead.
Through every trial, through every storm
His covenant will be our home
He parts the waves, He makes a way
To lead His children to the promised land.

Verse 2
Back to the city once again
For sacred words and ancient pen
Through suffering and bitter strife
The Lord preserved our very lives.
The daughters of Ishmael came
And joined our hearts in God’s great name
Through hunger, heat, and desert sand
He shaped us by His mighty hand.

Pre-Chorus
When brothers turned and hearts rebelled
And doubt like raging thunder fell
The Lord gave strength, the Lord gave sight
To build His purpose through the night.

Chorus
Into the wilderness we go
Where only faith and trust can grow
When God says move, we will obey
Though we don’t see the road ahead.
Through every trial, through every storm
His covenant will be our home
He parts the waves, He makes a way
To lead His children to the promised land.

Bridge
At Bountiful He showed the plan
Not by my might nor strength of man
He taught my hands to shape the wood
To trust that all He asks is good.
The waters roared, the tempest cried
My brothers fought, but God replied
He calmed the sea, He held us fast
His promises would always last.

Final Chorus (Lifted)
Across the mighty deep we sailed
No power of earth could make us fail
The God who speaks still leads today
His light will never fade away.
From desert dry to ocean wide
His faithful love will be our guide
And every step of faith we stand
Brings us closer to the promised land.

Outro
This is my record, this I write
Of God who turns our fear to light
I, Nephi, testify and stand—
The Lord will lead us to the promised land.
